registry.name: LifeOps Requirements Registry
registry.scope: The LifeOps example vertical: finance ingestion, categorisation, ledger integrity, budgeting, bills and the console views. The platform substrate and the factory are out of scope except where the vertical depends on them.
registry.purpose: Establish what the vertical is supposed to do, as testable statements, before work on it is filed. Every requirement carries acceptance criteria; verdicts are added by the operator's own measuring pass.
registry.method: This file is an example in the shape the tooling validates. Requirements record intent as a user story; scripts/requirements-load.py mirrors the story into the rationale the substrate requires.

conformance_legend.pass: Verified working against live data or code inspection.
conformance_legend.fail: Verified broken or verifiably not meeting the criterion.
conformance_legend.unverified: Plausibly implemented; not exercised. Do not treat as passing.

status_legend.partial: Built, conforms to some acceptance criteria only.
status_legend.defective: Built, but the implementation measures or does the wrong thing.

source_legend.derived-from-implementation: Intent inferred from code and docstrings.
source_legend.analyst-proposed: Proposed to close a gap; not yet approved.

bead_projection.link_via: bead_link to the dev.task beads that implement it

capabilities.name: Ingestion & Connectivity
capabilities.intent: Get every account's transactions and balances into Substrate, completely and continuously.

capabilities.name: Ingestion Observability
capabilities.intent: Know, without checking manually, whether the data is actually arriving.

capabilities.name: Categorization
capabilities.intent: Every transaction lands in a category the operator would agree with, or in a queue he can clear.

capabilities.name: Ledger Integrity
capabilities.intent: Know whether the recorded ledger matches reality, and by how much.

capabilities.name: Bills & Subscriptions
capabilities.intent: Nothing recurring bills unnoticed, hikes, or converts from a trial without warning.

user_story.so_that: I can dispute or cancel while it still matters

acceptance_criteria.given: the same merchant billing the same amount twice in 48h
acceptance_criteria.then: a duplicate_charge anomaly bead is raised
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: a recurring vendor's charge well above its moving average
acceptance_criteria.then: a price-hike anomaly is raised
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: no LLM is in the hot path, so results are reproducible
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: one message per run, deduped across the 20 daily executions
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

requirements.title: Every transaction is categorized through a rule → ML → LLM cascade

user_story.so_that: budgets and spend analysis work without manual entry

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction matching a committed rule
acceptance_criteria.then: the rule wins at confidence 1.0 and records categorization_rule_id
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry
acceptance_criteria.note: No live transaction in the 1349-row sample carries categorization_source='rule' — either no rules are committed, or rules are not reaching the hot path.

acceptance_criteria.then: that prediction is used and no LLM call is made
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: a category is assigned at confidence 0.8
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the assigned category is one the operator would agree with
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

requirements.title: The category taxonomy can express the deployment's actual money flows

user_story.i_want: a category for every kind of money movement I actually have
user_story.so_that: the classifier is not forced to lie

acceptance_criteria.then: it lands in an income category, not misc
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: a credit-card payment ('Online Payment, Thank You', 'Jpmorgan Chase Bank Na')
acceptance_criteria.then: it is a transfer, not spend
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: it maps to interest_fees or an income bucket, not misc
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: it is recognized as cash movement with a defined treatment
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the system marks it needs-enrichment rather than assigning misc at high confidence
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry
acceptance_criteria.note: Amazon is genuinely un-categorizable from the bank feed alone. It needs item-level data or a the operator decision, and the honest representation is 'unknown', not 'misc'.

requirements.title: Low-confidence categorization is surfaced for review

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction categorized below the confidence threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: it is counted in the low-confidence total
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the review set correlates with actual mis-categorization
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the operator can act on it — see the specific transactions, not just a number
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: each has an active, unpaused Temporal schedule

acceptance_criteria.then: the bead is marked state=removed rather than deleted

requirements.title: Per-institution connection health

user_story.i_want: one place that tells me whether each institution's connection is working
user_story.so_that: I can trust the ledger without spot-checking my bank apps

requirements.grant_evidence: "chase for instance was continuing to show synced even though we stop seeing data"

acceptance_criteria.given: an institution whose token is missing
acceptance_criteria.then: status is no_token
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: status is reauth_required and repairable=true
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: an institution whose sync job runs successfully but returns no data for N days
acceptance_criteria.then: status must NOT be 'ok'
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the label must distinguish 'job last ran' from 'data last arrived'
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: Plaid returns a non-reauth item error (rate limit, institution outage)
acceptance_criteria.then: the degraded condition is visible, not collapsed into healthy=true
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

user_story.i_want: to be told when an institution stops producing transactions for longer than is normal for that institution
user_story.so_that: a dead feed surfaces in days, not when I happen to notice

acceptance_criteria.given: an institution with an established transaction cadence
acceptance_criteria.when: the gap since its newest posted_date exceeds its own historical p95 gap
acceptance_criteria.then: a stale-feed condition is raised
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: a low-volume card that legitimately goes quiet for two weeks
acceptance_criteria.then: it does NOT alert — the threshold is per-institution, learned, not a global constant
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry
acceptance_criteria.note: amex has 18 transactions across 5 months; a global 3-day rule would alert on it constantly. This AC is what makes the requirement non-trivial.

acceptance_criteria.then: it appears in the console attention feed AND as a single Discord alert, subject to CAP-NTF policy
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: a stale-feed condition that has been raised
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition auto-resolves without manual clearing
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: it can state days-since-last-transaction per institution as a first-class field
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

user_story.i_want: an alert when a sync workflow crashes

acceptance_criteria.given: a bank-sync workflow about to fail
acceptance_criteria.then: a Discord alert names the institution and the error
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: the same failure recurring on every run
acceptance_criteria.then: the operator is interrupted at most once per policy window, not once per run
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

requirements.title: Nightly balance-delta reconciliation

user_story.i_want: to be told when an account's balance moved by more than its recorded transactions explain

requirements.grant_evidence: "I have drift detection that I don't really [think] serves the purpose its supposed to"

acceptance_criteria.given: a prior snapshot and the transactions since
acceptance_criteria.then: drift = current - (prev -/+ net_flow) is computed per account with liability sign handling
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: a pending finance.audit_discrepancy bead is upserted, not duplicated nightly
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the unexplained gap is still visible
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: an institution whose feed goes silent (no transactions AND no balance change)
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition is detected
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: there is a defined path to resolve, explain, or accept it
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

requirements.title: Cumulative ledger-integrity measure

user_story.i_want: a standing answer to 'how wrong is my ledger, in dollars, right now'
user_story.so_that: I know whether to trust the numbers I am making decisions on

acceptance_criteria.given: a detected drift that is never explained
acceptance_criteria.then: it accumulates into a running unexplained-variance figure per account
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: it states the anchor date and cumulative unexplained variance since
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator explains a discrepancy (accepts it, or adds the missing transaction)
acceptance_criteria.then: the baseline resets deliberately and the resolution is recorded
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.then: the ledger is marked untrustworthy in the console
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

requirements.note: The code docstring's reasoning for rejecting the naive sum is correct and should be preserved. The fix is an explicit anchor plus resolution lifecycle, not reverting to summing everything.

user_story.as_a: the operator who checks balances online and never hand-enters anything
user_story.i_want: the system to verify itself against the bank rather than against my data entry
user_story.so_that: I get integrity assurance without a workflow I will never perform

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator never logs manual expenses
acceptance_criteria.then: the assessment uses only signals derivable from the bank feed itself — balance-vs-transactions, feed freshness, categorization confidence
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.when: the quality alert is next changed
acceptance_criteria.then: it is removed rather than thresholded
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction that will never be paired with a manual entry
acceptance_criteria.then: state=posted is either terminal-by-design or the manual-pairing states are removed
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator checks his accounts online
acceptance_criteria.then: it matches what he sees in the bank app, and any divergence is the drift signal
